issue_context.title: systemd-timesyncd fails to sync time from NTP server with IPv6 address
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
systemd v249 and main branch

<!-- **NOTE:** Do not submit bug reports about anything but the two most recently released *major* systemd versions upstream! -->

**Used distribution**
 > OpenBMC

**Linux kernel version used** (`uname -a`)
<!-- Make sure to enclose the pasted kernel version in `backticks`, so that
     GitHub doesn't convert the `#` character typically included in it into a
     reference to old GitHub issues. -->
 > `5.10.53`

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > ARM

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
 > systemd-timesyncd should be able to sync time from NTP server with IPv6 address

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
 > It fails to sync time and get error message as below.

**Steps to reproduce the problem**
- Config the NTP server with IPv6 address
- Start systemd-timesyncd

**Additional program output to the terminal or log subsystem illustrating the issue**

<!-- Please paste relevant program terminal or journal output here, ideally
     when generated in debug mode (try setting the SYSTEMD_LOG_LEVEL=debug
     environment variable). For very long copy/pasted data consider using a
     service like https://gist.github.com/. Where copy/paste is not possible
     (for example early boot or late shutdown), a photo of the screen might do
     too, but text is always much preferred. -->
```text
systemd-timesyncd[534]: Error receiving message, disconnecting: Exchange full
```
comments:
The issue occurs after 3691bcf3c5eebdcca5b4f1c51c745441c57a6cd1
I tried to revert the related change in `src/timesync/timesyncd-manager.c` and the issue could be fixed.
See patch attached.
[0001-timesyncd-Use-recvmsg-instead-of-recvmsg_safe.txt](https://github.com/systemd/systemd/files/7014072/0001-timesyncd-Use-recvmsg-instead-of-recvmsg_safe.txt)

> Could you test #20488?

Tested with the patch, and the issue remains.
Could you show the last two line of the result `test-sizeof`?

> Could you show the last two line of the result `test-sizeof`?

```
timeval: 8
timespec: 8
```
It's on arm32.
Tested with https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/20567 and it works fine. Thanks!

review_comments:
`recvmsg_safe()` already handled the case.
You dropped the same check in resolved by 3691bcf3c5eebdcca5b4f1c51c745441c57a6cd1.
